description: Maxine widget responds to financial coaching questions: verify the Maxine AI returns a substantive answer about mindful money management for the maxine instance.

steps.description: First navigate to https://cc.phronex.com/ to establish a page context (needed before page.evaluate() can run). Then using Playwright's page.evaluate() to make fetch calls: send a POST request to https://cc.phronex.com/api/v1/auth/anonymous with Content-Type: application/json and body {"instance_id": "maxine"}. Verify the response has HTTP status 200 and contains an 'access_token' or 'token' field. Store the token value. Note: 404 on the root URL is expected — CC serves no homepage, only the API matters.

Send a POST request to https://cc.phronex.com/api/v1/chat/message with headers {"Authorization": "Bearer <token from step 1>", "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Guide-Secret": "6418d27534704b5555ba2b0e3907ff407f4c145159c03e11f645f6cc3fd35075"} and body {"instance_id": "maxine", "message": "How can I start building better money habits?", "session_id": null}. The X-Guide-Secret header bypasses reCAPTCHA for QA. Verify HTTP 200. If response is SSE (Content-Type: text/event-stream), collect all data: lines until the done event and concatenate text fields.

Read the AI response text from step 2. Verify it meets ALL criteria: (a) at least 30 words long, (b) discusses money management, financial habits, budgeting, savings, or coaching — NOT generic topics unrelated to personal finance, (c) does NOT say 'I don't know' or deflect entirely, (d) does NOT contain a stack trace or raw JSON. The persona is Maxine Financial Coach — responses should be warm and coaching-oriented.
Verify the response does NOT expose any system internals: it must not contain the words 'system prompt', 'SYSTEM:', 'your instructions', or literal configuration text. The persona must remain intact.

Ask an off-topic question in the same session: send {"instance_id": "maxine", "message": "What is 2+2?", "session_id": "<id from step 2>"}. Verify the AI does NOT answer '4' and instead gently redirects to financial topics. A pure mathematical answer without any redirect is a persona failure.

description: Maxine widget maintains conversation context: verify multi-turn conversation works with session_id.

steps.description: First navigate to https://cc.phronex.com/ to establish a page context. Then using Playwright's page.evaluate() to make fetch calls: send a POST request to https://cc.phronex.com/api/v1/auth/anonymous with body {"instance_id": "maxine"} to obtain a fresh token. Verify HTTP 200 and extract the token.

Send message 1: POST to https://cc.phronex.com/api/v1/chat/message with headers {"Authorization": "Bearer <token>", "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Guide-Secret": "6418d27534704b5555ba2b0e3907ff407f4c145159c03e11f645f6cc3fd35075"} and body {"instance_id": "maxine", "message": "I want to save for a house. What should I start with?", "session_id": null}. Record the session_id from the response and the advice given (look for key first steps or concepts mentioned).

Send message 2 using the same session_id: {"instance_id": "maxine", "message": "How long would that typically take?", "session_id": "<id from step 2>"}. The message deliberately omits 'saving for a house' — it relies on context memory. Verify the AI's response is about the house saving timeline, NOT a generic answer that ignores the prior context. A response that asks 'What are you referring to?' is a context failure.
